locationText: SF/NYC On-site / Remote US Healthcare in the U.S
description:
Komodo Health | Principal Product Manager, AI Products | Full-Time | $213k-$288k + equity... | SF/NYC On-site / Remote US Healthcare in the U.S. is a mess, and most of the data that could help is locked in places nobody can use. Komodo has mapped the patient journey across the country: diagnoses, treatments, providers, payers. Our customers are pharma companies, payers and health systems that want to act on that picture. We're building the platform that puts it in their hands. There's an AI analyst that works across the whole map. There are apps that turn a population described in plain English into a full report in seconds, and tools that let analysts open, check and rerun the code behind every answer. Underneath all of it is a single query engine that every app and agent shares, so a new product is weeks of work instead of quarters. Building has gotten cheap. Deciding what to build is the hard part now, and that's the job. We want product managers who: • Have shipped data, analytics or developer products that people use every day

• Prototype things themselves with AI coding tools, and would rather show a working version than write a spec

• Can sit with a customer, find the problem underneath the request, and say no to the rest

• Write clearly and briefly
Healthcare experience helps, but it isn't required. Curiosity about how the system actually works is.

Small team, real customers, and more leverage per person than I've seen anywhere. If that sounds like you, email our head of product at
kaushal.parikh@komodohealth.com
Or me at ramraj.velmurugan@komodohealth.com Please include the keyword from my HN profile in the subject of the email!

title: Technical GTM Enablement Manager
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

OPPORTUNITY

Deepgram is expanding our enablement function, and we're hiring our first Technical GTM Enablement Manager. This role is the force multiplier for the technical side of our revenue organization. You will own how our pre-sales and post-sales technical teams ramp, stay current, and prove they are ready, sitting at the intersection of Product, Applied Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales.

Our technical field teams run demos, guide architecture decisions, troubleshoot live integrations, and take customers to production. You are not here to teach them their jobs. You are here to make what our best technologists already do repeatable for everyone else, and to get new hires there faster.

This is not a training delivery role, and it is not externally facing content creation. Most of what should exist does not exist yet. You will build it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own onboarding and ramp for technical GTM roles, designing and continuously improving a structured program that gets new hires to productivity faster and creating a consistent technical standard across teams.

- Build technical field framework and playbooks, including:

- Technical discovery with buyers, developers, and evaluators

- POC and evaluation standards, including clear technical and business success criteria

- Architecture guidance for our most common customer patterns

- Technical handoffs across pre-sales and post-sales

- Escalation readiness, turning what we learn from individual customer issues into reusable guidance

- Build and run technical certifications, keeping it current as the platform changes rapidly underneath it.

- Lead technical readiness for launches, partnering with Product and PMM so technical teams are ready before GA rather than after.

- Turn subject matter expertise into scalable enablement, pulling what sits in the heads of Product, PMM, and our strongest field technologists and turning it into something repeatable.

- Partner with Sales Enablement where the sale turns technical, including technical discovery, evaluation strategy, competitive differentiation, and solution positioning

- Operate AI-first

title: Vice President Finance Operations (FINOP)
description:
Mutual of America Financial Group
Job Title: Vice President, Finance Operations (FINOP)
Location: Remote or hybrid if one resides in the greater NYC area
Who Are We:
At Mutual of America Financial Group , we help people build the assets they need to achieve greater financial security. Our Company is built upon a solid foundation of integrity, excellence, and social responsibility. We were founded in 1945 to provide small and mid-sized nonprofit organizations with pension and retirement-related services, along with leading customer support. Today, we provide these services also to for-profit companies, as well as to governmental entities, Tribal enterprises, institutional investors, and individuals. We work diligently to understand the needs of our customers so we can help them achieve their retirement goals.
We are committed to bringing talented and motivated people together to help our customers achieve a financially secure future.
Role Summary:
The Vice President, Financial Operations (FINOP) serves as the designated financial and operational principal for the broker-dealer and is responsible for ensuring the firm's compliance with all applicable SEC, FINRA, and other regulatory requirements. This role provides strategic oversight of capital management, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and operational risk while partnering closely with senior leadership, Compliance, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
The VP, FINOP serves as a trusted advisor to executive management and plays a critical role in maintaining the firm's financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational effectiveness.
Responsibilities:
1. Regulatory Oversight & Compliance

• Serve as the firm's designated FINOP and maintain all responsibilities associated with the Series 27 Financial and Operations Principal registration.

• Ensure ongoing compliance with SEC, FINRA, SIPC, and applicable state regulatory requirements.

• Prepare, review, and file FOCUS Reports and other regulatory filings accurately and timely.

• Monitor compliance with net capital, reserve, and liquidity requirements.

• Act as the primary liaison with regulatory agencies, external auditors, and examiners regarding financial and operational matters.

2. Financial Management & Reporting

• Oversee the broker-dealer's accounting records, financial reporting, and general ledger processes.

• Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

• Analyze financial performance, capital adequacy, and operational metrics.

• Provide financial guidance and recommendations to senior leadership.

• Ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data and regulatory reporting.

3. Risk Management & Controls

• Develop, implement, and maintain effective internal controls and supervisory procedures.

• Identify and assess operational, financial, and regulatory risks.

• Recommend and implement corrective actions to mitigate identified risks.

• Support enterprise risk management initiatives and regulatory change management efforts.

4. Operational Leadership

• Oversee operational processes supporting broker-dealer activities.

• Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, Operations, Technology, and Finance teams to ensure effective operational controls.

• Evaluate and enhance operational efficiencies while maintaining regulatory compliance.

• Review vendor relationships, service providers, and clearing arrangements.

5. Strategic Partnership

• Advise executive leadership on the financial and operational impact of business initiatives, regulatory developments, and strategic opportunities.

• Participate in strategic planning and governance discussions.

• Support business growth initiatives while ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements.

Required Qualifications:

• Active Series 27 (Financial and Operations Principal) license.

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 10+ years of progressive experience within broker-dea

title: Technical Program Manager, Electrical Equipment
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE ENGINEERING PROGRAM MANAGEMENT TEAM

You'll join the technical program managers who run Fluidstack's infrastructure R&D programs. This role sits with the Electrical Equipment product engineering group, which is designing the medium-voltage switchgear, low-voltage switchboards and busway, and prefabricated electrical skids and e-houses that Fluidstack will manufacture in its own factory rather than buy from the market. Your job is to drive those designs from concept to a released, manufacturable product on a schedule the factory and the build can hold.

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Taking equipment that the industry buys as catalog products and re-engineering it as Fluidstack-owned designs with a bill of materials, drawings, and test procedures a factory line can build to.

- Running concept, preliminary, and critical design reviews across several equipment families in parallel and closing the actions they generate.

- Qualifying the components and sub-suppliers each design depends on, with second sources, before the design is frozen.

- Handing a released design to manufacturing engineering with the documentation, tooling, and test plan needed for the first production lot.

ROLE SCOPE

- Drive the design program. Own the integrated plan for one or more electrical equipment product lines from requirements through design release, and hold the engineering team to its gates.

- Run the design reviews. Schedule and run concept, preliminary, and critical design reviews, capture decisions and actions, and close them before the next gate.

- Make it manufacturable. Bring manufacturing engineering, quality, and supply chain into the design early so bills of materials, tolerances, and test procedures are ready when the design releases.

- Manage the component supply. Track long-lead components, sub-supplier qualification, and second sourcing against the design schedule, and escalate what will slip.

- Hold the configuration. Keep specifications, drawings, and change requests in one controlled set so the factory builds what engineering released.

- Report the truth. Keep program status, risks, and spend visible to engineering leadership without waiting to be asked.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.c

About The Job:

We are looking for a Maintenance Technician to be responsible for fixing, maintaining and improving our equipment on site to make sure everything is working as it should at all times.

The Maintenance Tech will be responsible for completing reactive and preventative works across the site, reporting defects to contractors, assisting contractors, keeping up to date on defect tickets raised on our CMMS system and following the sites Health and Safety rules.

What You Will Be Doing:

• Perform planned preventative maintenance (PPM) on plant and equipment, including automated conveying systems, gravity conveying systems with label applicators scanners, thermoforming equipment, refrigeration plant (CO2), hi-speed roller doors, dock levellers

• Identify defects that arise while completing PPMs and undertake rectifications, recording actions taken in the maintenance manual and CMMS system.

• Conduct minor structural and electrical improvement works.

• Provide reactive support when required, including breakdown response, and ensure high standards and timely completion of work.

• Supervise contractors to ensure works are completed in accordance with the specification, and report any issues with contractors to maintenance manager.

• Comply with all Health and Safety requirements of the site at all times.

• Work proactively with maintenance shift manager to manage task volumes, provide regular updates on task status, and identify problems with plant efficiency and determine rectification measures.

• Support operational projects on an ad-hoc basis.

• Flag low stock levels to ensure inventory stays within min-max levels using our CMMS system.

Who You Are:

• Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work well both independently and as part of a team.

• Strong commitment to health and safety.

• Previous experience in maintenance or engineering field preferred.

• Knowledge of automated systems and PLC controls.

• Experience in electrical and mechanical maintenance.

• Basic computer skills with experience in CMMS or similar systems.

• Flexibility to work shifts and weekends as required.

Next steps : Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.

title: Digital Media Sales & Account Manager (m/w)
description:
Werde Digital Media Sales & Account Manager (m/w) bei Carwow in München.

Wichtig: Diese Rolle hat einen klaren Vertriebsfokus.

Das heißt: Du verkaufst unsere digitalen Mediaprodukte YouTube, Meta und Data an Automobilhersteller, Partner und Mediaagenturen und begleitest die Kampagnen von der Buchung bis zur Aussteuerung.

Du bist dir nicht ganz sicher, ob die Position zu dir passt? Bewirb dich und lass es uns gemeinsam herausfinden.

Unsere Mission

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel. Wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt.

Unsere Reichweite geht weit über die eigene Plattform hinaus: 10 Mio. YouTube Abonnenten und mehr als 350 Mio. Online Leser pro Jahr in der Gruppe. Genau diese Reichweite und unsere Daten machen wir jetzt für Werbekunden auch außerhalb von Carwow nutzbar.

Dein Impact @ Carwow

Du baust die Säule Digital Media, Audiences und Data im deutschen OEM & Media Team aus. Unsere Brand Partnerships Manager:innen verkaufen Retail Media auf der Plattform. Du sorgst dafür, dass Carwow auch in den Mediaplänen der Agenturen fest gesetzt ist.

Dafür hast du drei Produkte im Gepäck. Du schnürst daraus Pakete, die zu den Zielen der Partner passen und verbindest sie mit unserem Retail Media Angebot zu einer durchgängigen Media Story bis zum Kauf. So wächst ein noch junger Umsatzstrom zu einem festen Standbein, und du prägst ihn von Anfang an mit.

YouTube: Bewegtbildkampagnen im Carwow Umfeld und mit Carwow Zielgruppen, von Awareness bis Klick

Meta: Kampagnen auf Facebook und Instagram, ausgesteuert auf Menschen, die gerade nachweislich ein Auto suchen

Data: Datenberatung auf Basis der Carwow Daten, verbunden mit unserem Verständnis des deutschen Automarkts

Und neue Produkte: Weitere Formate und Ideen, die wir gerade entwickeln. Du bringst ein, was Kunden und Agenturen brauchen, und führst neue Produkte in den Markt ein

Deine Aufgaben als Digital Media Sales & Account Manager (m/w)

- Du verantwortest den Umsatz mit YouTube, Meta und Data im deutschen Markt und baust ihn gezielt aus (genau hier brauchst du eine "Hunter Mentalität" im Vertrieb)

- Du bist erste Ansprechperson für die Mediaagenturen der Automobilhersteller, von den großen Networks bis zu den spezialisierten Häusern, und kennst dort Planung, Einkauf und Strategie

- Du gewinnst gemeinsam mit unseren Brand Partnerships Manager:innen die Marketing und Mediaverantwortlichen der OEMs für unsere Digitalprodukte

- Du beantwortest Briefings mit Mediaplänen und Angebote, die sich an den KPIs der Kunden messen lassen, und überzeugst mit starken Pitches

- Du bringst gewonnene Kampagnen sauber in die Buchung: Angebot, Auftrag, Übergabe an Media Operations und Abstimmung von Assets, Laufzeiten und Tracking

- Du steuerst laufende Kampagnen gemeinsam mit Media Operations aus, optimierst auf die vereinbarten KPIs, ordnest Reportings für Kunden ein und machst aus guten Ergebnissen Folgebuchungen und Jahresvereinbarungen

- Du entwickelst mit Produkt, Analytics und Media Operations unsere Angebote weiter und bringst zurück, was Agenturen wirklich brauchen

... und du pflegst deine Pipeline und deinen Forecast so, dass wir uns darauf gemeinsam verlassen können

Dein Profil

Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifiziert und Lust auf richtig guten Mediavertrieb hast, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Denn wir wollen gemeinsam mit dir wachsen.

- Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Mediavertrieb mit, zum Beispiel bei einem Vermarkter, Publisher, einer Plattform oder auf Agenturseite

- Du kennst die deutsche Agenturlandschaft und hast idealerweise ein belastbares Netzwerk in den Agenturen

- Du hast digitale Kampagnen selbst aufgesetzt und ausgesteuert, idealerweise in DV360 (YouTube) und im Meta Ads

title: Senior Manager, Qualitative Evaluation and Insights
description:
Who We Are
The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation .
The Role
CDI is seeking a rigorous, disciplined, and analytically sharp Senior Manager to serve as the qualitative expert behind our campus consulting work. Reporting to the Senior Director of Campus Culture Change, you will collect and code the interview, focus group, and survey data our engagements run on, and turn it into the findings our university partners act on.
This is a hands-on analysis role. You will run qualitative data collection across a portfolio of campus engagements, code consistently against CDI's shared frameworks, and hold the line on coding quality across projects. You will draft reports, memos, and client-facing narratives, and build the materials that carry findings to internal and external audiences. You will also partner with other team members to build qualitative case studies and institutional spotlights.
What You’ll Do
Research Design and Delivery

• Collect and code interview, focus group, and open-ended survey data across a portfolio of campus consulting engagements, applying CDI's coding frameworks consistently from project to project.

• Serve as lead liaison with the Research team and contribute to codeframe updates

• Coordinate data collection logistics with campus partners, sequencing fieldwork around the academic calendar.

Measurement and Evaluation

• Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify the themes, patterns, and findings that inform engagement recommendations and deliverables.

• Own engagement deliverables: reports, memos, presentations, client-facing narratives

• Present findings and recommendations to external stakeholders

Research Partnership & Thought Leadership

• Build CDI's approach to assessing campus and Institutional Change Model consulting initiatives.

• Conduct interviews and draft case studies that surface what is working across our campus partnerships.

• Identify institutional spotlights for Culture Change projects, partnering with Communications.

• Advise colleagues and partners on measuring organizational culture and the conditions for dialogue and open inquiry

Requirements
Who You Are
Required

• A trained qualitative researcher. You bring 5+ years of applied qualitative research experience, or a graduate degree with substantial fieldwork, and you've run interviews and focus groups yourself.

• Disciplined with a codebook. You code high volumes of data consistently and know which discrepancies to escalate and which to resolve on the spot. Experience with multi-coder QA or inter-rater reliability is a strong plus.

• A clear analytic writer. You move from coded data to findings without overstating them, separate what participants said from what you infer, and integrate survey results with qualitative data.

• Organized across a portfolio. You keep several engagements moving without losing track of which campus, which codebook version, and which deadline.

• Grounded in organizational culture measurement. You assess culture beyond a single survey score, design approaches that combine interviews, documents, and survey data, and can explain what a given measure can and cannot tell us.

• A steady partner to campus contacts. You coordinate with institutional research, academic leadership, and student affairs, and you plan around the academic calendar, not against it.

title: Enterprise Security Engineer, Vulnerability Management
description:
About the Team

Enterprise Security protects the systems, identities, devices, and services that enable OpenAI's employees to work securely and effectively. We partner across IT and Security to understand risk, build practical defenses, and support a rapidly evolving technical environment.

About the Role

We are looking for an Enterprise Security Engineer with a focus on vulnerability management, novel vulnerabilities, and zero-day response. You will investigate vulnerabilities and security weaknesses across networks, endpoints, and SaaS, prioritize them in the context of real exposure, and drive remediation through verified outcomes.

You will also build security capabilities and automation, use AI agents to solve practical problems, and help shape how enterprise security operates as agents become a larger part of everyday work.

This role is open to candidates in San Francisco, CA, and to remote candidates in the United States.

In this role, you will:

- Discover, investigate, and prioritize vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across enterprise systems, including novel vulnerabilities and zero-days with incomplete information and no established playbook.

- Translate technical findings into clear attack paths, business impact, and actionable remediation.

- Develop and validate emergency mitigations when patches are unavailable, coordinate with system owners, vendors, and incident responders, and drive durable fixes through verified closure.

- Improve asset visibility, ownership, vulnerability data quality, and reporting.

- Build and operate security tools and integrations using code, APIs, automation, and AI agents.

- Design controls for agent access, execution, and accountability.

- Contribute across endpoint, network, identity, and SaaS security, and support incident investigations when needed.

- Have independently investigated novel or emerging vulnerabilities and driven enterprise remediation from uncertain initial reports through mitigation and verified closure.

- Have solved substantive problems using AI agents and can explain how you evaluated and corrected their work.

- Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. We are hiring an Associate Director, Programmatic to build and lead Darkroom's programmatic capability inside the Paid Media function. Our next stage requires deeper expertise across Amazon DSP, CTV, OLV, Retail Media Networks, high-impact display, and privacy-safe media environments, and you'll be the person who builds that sub-function from the ground up.

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer, providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

THE AGENCY BEHIND THE PRODUCT

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom, a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the programmatic function you build here gets tested against real client budgets and real business outcomes from day one, and feeds directly into Shadow's programmatic backbone.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- With support from the Paid Media MD, build Darkroom's programmatic media capability across Amazon DSP, CTV, OLV, RMNs, display, and high-impact media.

- Lead strategy, planning, activation, optimization, and measurement for programmatic campaigns across key client accounts.

At our core is the Celonis Context Model - which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

As a Senior Value Engineer specializing in Banking , you are at the forefront of solving business-critical problems for some of the world's largest financial institutions. You will work intimately with strategic enterprise clients to understand their complex objectives-ranging from accelerating Loan Origination and Client Onboarding to optimizing Capital Markets Operations and Regulatory Reporting .

You will build Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with top AI and ML technology partners. By feeding operational context to AI, you help banks understand the intricate realities of their massive transactional ecosystems. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Banking Executives (COOs, CROs, and Heads of Digital Transformation), and ensure successful implementation and value realization to solidify and expand the Celonis footprint across the global financial landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

• AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand the clients' overarching AI strategies and the distinct challenges inherent to Banking (e.g., fraud detection, credit risk assessment, and automating KYC/AML). Translate complex financial workflows into innovative AI solutions that drive measurable ROI.

• Pre- and Post-Sales Execution: Actively drive the customer lifecycle. Lead technical discovery and capability demonstrations during the expansion cycle. Remain deeply involved post-sale to guide implementation, ensuring efficiency and adoption thresholds are met.

• Hackathons & Prototyping: Think creatively to tackle heavily siloed legacy core-banking systems. Leverage cutting-edge AI to rapidly build prototypes in client hackathons, solving pain points across Settlements, Reconciliations, and Payments.

• Agentic Process Transformation: Support enterprise clients in shifting from rule-based automation to autonomous AI agents. Enable "intelligent" banking processes, such as autonomous exception handling in Trade Ops or automated Complaints Management .

• Proof Projects: Execute end-to-end Business-critical Proof-of-Value projects. Architect secure, scalable LLM/agent systems (with RAG and guardrails) that integrate with complex enterprise stacks like SAP Banking, Salesforce FINS, or core-banking ledgers.

• Domain Practitioner Leadership: Serve as a functional subject matter expert for the Banking value chain, scaling knowledge across the organization regarding the nuances of financial operations and transaction lifecycles.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales and post-sales engagements specifically within complex Banking or Financial Services environments. This includes building ROI business cases and guiding technical implementations.

• Strong Domain Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the banking value chain, with the ability to translate operational needs into AI use cases across:

• Lending & Onboarding: Loan Origination, KYC/AML, and Banking & Lending.

• Capital Markets: Sales & Trading Ops, Settlements, Reconciliations, and Custody Services.

• Support & Governance: Finance, Risk & Controls, and Regulatory/Transaction Reporting.

• Expertise in Generative AI Techniques

title: Senior Director, Patient Advocacy & Communications Lead, EMEA
description:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.
As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.
 
Summary of Position:

The Patient Advocacy & Corporate Communications Lead, EMEA will be responsible for developing and executing integrated patient advocacy and communications strategies that advance the company's mission, strengthen stakeholder trust, and support business objectives across the region, starting with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) and including  facioscapulohumeral dystrophy (FSHD) in line with clinical development milestones. 

This role will serve as the primary EMEA lead for patient advocacy engagement while also driving corporate and product communications, executive visibility, disease awareness initiatives, and internal communications. The successful candidate will engage the SMA community (and communities for future disease states) to establish and solidify trust and act as a connector to patient and advocate perspectives to drive Scholar Rock’s patient first values. They will act as a trusted strategic advisor to regional leadership and work cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Global patient advocacy and communications, Market Access, Clinical Development, Regulatory, and Commercial Teams, supported by global and regional agency partners.

The ideal candidate combines deep understanding of the rare disease community with exceptional communications and stakeholder management capabilities and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial biotech environment.

• Comfortable learning new systems and adapting to evolving payroll processes.

Nice to have:

• Experience managing payroll across multiple countries.

title: Staff Product Manager, Search and AI Visibility - US (Remote)
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Role Overview
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own how our clients get found in search and AI: more than 20,000 real estate websites, each competing in its own market, with a real business depending on the outcome. This is a platform product, where one good product decision reaches thousands of businesses at once.
Search is being rebuilt in real time. Our clients are evaluated by Google, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both.
This is a product leadership role. You'll run this area like a business: set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and work across design, client success, and sales to make it land. It is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one.
What You'll Do
Own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for organic discovery and AI visibility across every site on the platform, including what clients can see, control, and get credit for
Spend real time with clients and the teams who serve them, and turn what you learn into a clear point of view on what to build next
Build the business case for your roadmap and tie it to retention, revenue, and client outcomes
Make our clients' brands, listings, and expertise legible to AI assistants, and define how we measure citations and visibility across answer engines
Own the technical foundations every client site depends on, partnering with engineering and the team building our next-generation website platform so recurring problems get solved once through better defaults, automation, or safeguards
Prove changes on representative groups of sites, establish real impact, then scale what works
Ship with your own engineering and design partners, writing requirements clear enough that the team moves without waiting on you
Partner with client success, sales, and marketing so launches land and clients understand the value we deliver
Who You Are
7+ years of product management, including owning a product line end to end where you were accountable for adoption, client outcomes, and revenue
You run your area like a business. You build the case before you build the product, tie your roadmap to retention and revenue, and own the result
Close to your customers. You talk to them often, understand their business, and can explain why something matters in their terms, not just in rankings
You create momentum in ambiguity. You narrow the problem, make a call, and move before every question is answered
Strong opinions, honestly tested. You form a point of view, go looking for the counterargument, and change your mind when the evidence says so
You make complex things simple for non-technical users, favoring smart defaults and guardrails over configuration
A communicator who can get a room excited, from engineers to executives to client success, and who earns trust across teams you don't manage
Hands-on experience with SEO or organic growth and a current point of view on AI search, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and to know which details actually move results
Rigorous about measurement. You test before you scale and can tell a result from a coincidence
Fluent with AI as a working tool, using it to investigate, prototype, and unblock yourself

ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll take technical ownership of complex business domains, designing, building, and evolving scalable, reliable backend services for our enterprise spend management platform.

What you'll be working on:

- Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services.

- Applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model complex business domains and define clear service boundaries.

- Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles.

- Designing APIs, service integrations, and reliable asynchronous workflows using technologies such as Temporal.

- Designing secure authentication and authorization solutions, applying standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and WebAuthn, as well as fine-grained authorization models.

- Ensuring scalability, security, observability, and resilience in production.

- Continuously improving shared libraries, project structure, development tooling, and automated quality assurance practices to promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across services.

- Driving architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and mentoring other engineers.

- Leveraging AI extensively but responsibly, including developing guardrails, agent harnesses, and tooling to maintain engineering quality in a fast-paced environment.

We primarily use Node.js with TypeScript, but strong engineering fundamentals matter more to us than experience with a particular language. Our technology stack also includes Temporal, SpiceDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis.

This is a 80/20 hands-on technical leadership role, combining deep engineering work with architectural ownership and influence across teams.
Remote, but travel to Amsterdam or other offsite meetings in Europe might occasionally be requested

YOUR COLLEAGUES WOULD SAY YOU

- Lead by example and raise the bar with pragmatism and care.

- Communicate clearly, listen well, and bring people along in decisions.

- Enjoy breaking down complex problems, gathering input, and driving to a solution.

- Coach others and create space for people to grow.

- Prefer progress over perfection, while still caring deeply about quality.

 

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us - with catering in our Lisbon, Copenhagen and London offices or a monthly lunch allowance paid directly together with your salary in other markets

- Private health insurance to ensure you’re fit in body and mind to do your best work

- Wellbeing days - fully paid days off designed for a slower pace, allowing you to take time to recharge and prioritise self-care

- We provide access to MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and wellbeing support with great success so far

title: GRC Analyst
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a GRC Analyst to join our Compliance & Security team and help make risk management, audit and compliance a continuous part of how Supabase runs. You’ll work closely with engineering, security, IT, and legal to help us define our risk tolerance, keep our compliance programs (including SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022) current, test controls on a rolling basis, and answer customer and vendor security reviews quickly and accurately.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Run risk assessments across the company and major product changes. Score likelihood and impact, propose treatments, and bring the results to leadership to inform risk tolerance decisions.

- Maintain the risk register, track remediation to closure, and report status to compliance and security leadership.

- Monitor controls on a rolling basis, using automated tests where they exist and manual testing where they don’t. Triage failures, prioritize by the risk register, and align each finding with an owner and a due date.

- Support internal audit, whether performed by an external partner or in-house: propose scope from the risk register, supply evidence, and track findings to closure.

- Run day-to-day operations for our compliance programs: evidence collection, control owner follow-up, and readiness ahead of each audit period.

title: Engineering Manager - Consumer
description:
Plaid Link is the front door to modern financial experiences. It securely connects people’s financial accounts to the apps and services they trust, and it’s the foundation Plaid’s product teams build onboarding, payments, identity, and lending experiences on. Link supports more than 12,000 financial institutions and 9,000+ apps and services, is used by roughly one in two adults with a bank account, and is the starting point for approximately 750,000 connections every day.

The Unified Link team is now focused on building a single onboarding platform for Plaid’s products. Customers will integrate once through a single API and turn on additional products with a toggle in the dashboard, making it easy to adopt new capabilities and expand their use of Plaid.

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead roughly ten engineers through a major transformation: bringing our existing onboarding products together, moving Link’s highest-traffic experiences onto the new foundation without disrupting the traffic they carry every day, and continuing to improve the Link experience along the way. You’ll partner closely with a Principle Engineer and the team’s Tech Lead to set technical direction and sequence the migration, and with Product, Design, and teams across Plaid to make the platform easy to adopt and extend. All while maintaining a high bar for quality and reliability, and growing your engineers through clear priorities, coaching, and feedback.

Responsibilities

- Set team strategy and the technical roadmap in partnership with the Tech Lead, balancing the platform migration with ongoing improvements to Link

- Drive team execution (planning, sprints, delivery) and hold a high technical bar through hands-on involvement in design and code review

- Hire, manage, and develop a team of engineers, including goal setting, coaching, feedback, and performance management

- Partner with Product, Design, and engineering teams across Plaid to define clear interfaces and make the unified platform easy to adopt and extend

- Keep Link reliable and healthy through the transition, making sound tradeoffs between new work and long-term system health

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience as a backend or full-stack engineer, with a track record of designing and shipping complex, scalable systems

- 2+ years managing engineers, including coaching, performance management, and building a team

- Strong technical depth: you can dive into architecture and design details, and credibly hold a high bar for the team

- Strong user empathy and the ability to balance technical tradeoffs with product outcomes

- Nice to have: experience building consumer-facing products and/or product led growth (PLG) dev tools

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Retrieval & Targeting
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Team Description:
The Ads Retrieval ML team builds the machine learning systems that identify relevant advertising candidates for Reddit users. Retrieval sits at the heart of the ads delivery funnel: before downstream ranking and auction decisions, our models determine which campaigns and ads are eligible to compete. We work on large-scale retrieval across multiple objectives, placements, and geographies. Our work combines representation learning, candidate generation, nearest-neighbor search, behavioral and contextual signals, and rigorous offline and online experimentation.
Role Description:
We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to provide technical leadership for the Retrieval and Targeting ML team. You will lead the design and evolution of retrieval models and modeling practices that improve relevance, advertiser outcomes, and user experience at Reddit scale. This is an applied ML role centered on retrieval modeling and end-to-end product impact. You will be expected to stay close to the technical details-from data and objective design through model development, evaluation, experimentation, and launch-while setting direction for other engineers.
Responsibilities:

• Define the technical direction and multi-year roadmap for ads retrieval modeling in partnership with engineering, product, data science, and ads stakeholders.

• Design, develop, and launch candidate-generation and retrieval models for campaigns and ads across Reddit ’s advertising surfaces.

• Apply modern approaches such as two-tower architectures, representation learning, embeddings, sequence models, graph-based methods, and other deep learning techniques when they create meaningful product value.

• Improve the retrieval stack across key modeling decisions, including objectives, labels, sampling strategies, hard-negative mining, feature design, embedding generation, candidate filtering, and retrieval depth.

• Work with approximate nearest-neighbor and vector retrieval systems, reasoning about recall, relevance, freshness, diversity, coverage, latency, and cost trade-offs.

• Establish strong evaluation practices that connect retrieval metrics-such as recall, precision, candidate coverage, calibration, and downstream lift-to ads and user outcomes.

• Lead offline analysis and online experiments, interpret ambiguous results, and translate findings into the next modeling iteration.

• Partner with downstream ranking, ads platform, auction, measurement, and product teams to ensure retrieval models integrate effectively into the full ads funnel.

• Write design documents, review code and model changes, and raise the quality bar for modeling, testing, observability, and production ownership.

• Mentor ML engineers and help grow the team’s expertise in retrieval, recommendation, and representation learning.

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of industry experience, including substantial experience building and shipping applied ML products.

title: Co-Op, Robot Perception & State Estimation
description:
Your Impact at LILA

As a Co-Op on the Production Robotics team at Lila Sciences, you will help build the algorithms and software that let our robots know where they are and what they are looking at, so they can run scientific workflows reliably inside the AI Science Factories (AISFs). The team develops the state estimation, perception, and testing infrastructure that general-purpose robotic skills depend on.

Your work will sit at the intersection of estimation, computer vision, and robotics software. You will help improve how our mobile bases estimate their position and motion, develop camera-based detection and localization of AprilTags and lab instruments, and strengthen the simulation-based testing and CI that validate changes before they reach hardware. Expect a mix of writing production-quality software, applying math to real sensor data, and debugging real-world behavior on physical robots.

You will work alongside robotics engineers, AI researchers, and software engineers, with day-to-day support from the Production Robotics team. The output is software that runs in production lab environments and directly accelerates the rate at which Lila can run experiments.

What You'll Be Building

• Fuse multi-sensor data to improve mobile base state estimation

• Build camera-based AprilTag and instrument detection and localization for robot manipulation and navigation

• Develop new robot capabilities in ROS 2 (Jazzy)

• Expand simulation-based tests and CI pipelines so changes are validated before deployment on hardware

• Evaluate estimation and perception performance on real robot data and contribute fixes back to the codebase

• Ship production code alongside robotics, software, and AI engineers

• Document algorithms, test approaches, and integration patterns for the rest of the team

What You'll Need to Succeed

• In-progress Master's (preferred) or strong senior-year Bachelor's in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a controls/estimation leaning

• Proficiency in Python and/or C++, with coursework or project experience writing well-tested code

• Familiarity with state estimation and sensor fusion (e.g., Kalman filtering)

• Strong foundation in linear algebra and probability

• Comfort with Git and Linux development environments

• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across a multidisciplinary team

• Available for the full spring co-op term

Bonus Points For

• Experience with ROS 2 (Jazzy preferred) or another robotics framework

• Hands-on experience with camera systems and computer vision (e.g., OpenCV, AprilTags, camera calibration)

• Experience with simulation-based testing and CI (e.g., Gazebo, GitHub Actions)

• Experience integrating software with sensors, actuators, or other physical systems

• Coursework or projects in localization, SLAM, or robot control

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

Before anyone reads a word we write, they have already formed an opinion of us from how we look.

Every month, Conveo ships hundreds of pieces of visual work: the website, landing pages, sales decks, films, social posts, event booths, reports that land on the desks of executives at Unilever, Google, and Orange. That work is made by many hands, internal people, external partners, freelancers, and increasingly AI agents. What is missing is the one person who owns what it all adds up to.

That is this role. You hold the visual language of the entire company: what Conveo looks like, why it looks that way, and how every team, from marketing to sales to events to the founders themselves, produces work that looks like it came from the same brain. When a buyer decides in three seconds whether we look like a company they can trust with their biggest questions, they are judging your work.

The timing is the once-in-a-career part. We are rebuilding the entire brand this year, with a funded rebrand agency, a funded freelance bench, and a green field behind them. Your design system will be executed by people and by machines. When you encode a rule well, our agents apply it on every asset, at any hour, at a volume no design team could match. As a Casting Talent specialist, you are the detective and the connector. You aren't just filling roles; you are finding the specific personalities that make a viewer stop scrolling and start listening.

Scout & Source Creators

• Build a diverse roster of actors, models, UGC creators, and real-people testimonials suitable for beauty, fashion, and tech brands.

ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Design and deliver production-grade AI agents https://sierra.ai/blog/meet-the-ai-agent-engineer: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes-they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.

- Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle https://sierra.ai/blog/agent-development-life-cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

- Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups in Silicon Valley, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

- Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.

EXAMPLE PROJECTS

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

- Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn

- Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalizing product recommendations

- Create generalizable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog https://sierra.ai/blog/five-ways-to-use-ai-agents-financial-services!

- Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development

- Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems

- Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

title: Senior Field Solutions Engineer
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

To further expand our team, we are looking for you as Senior Field Solutions Engineer to join our Austin-based team. Your role will be central to ensuring successful implementation and ongoing performance of our robotic solutions at customer sites throughout the United States. You will play a critical part in scaling our solutions and providing technical leadership and support.

Your Responsibilities

- Development and Testing: Take ownership of robotic solution concepts from detailed design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support within our Austin facility and at customer locations.

- Customer Deployment and Integration: Lead the technical deployment and commissioning of RobCo's robotic automation systems at customer sites, ensuring seamless integration with existing production environments. Identify operational gaps and proactively build systems, tools, and best practices that enable teams to scale effectively across multiple deployments and projects.

- Customer-Centric Approach: Deeply understand and articulate customer needs, translating complex requirements into straightforward, effective automation solutions.

- Technical Support and Training: Provide comprehensive on-site support and training, assist in troubleshooting, and ensure customer satisfaction through responsive and effective service.

- Documentation: Develop detailed technical documentation, user manuals, and operational guides to support customer understanding and effective use of our systems.

- Innovation and Feedback: Collaborate closely with RobCo's hardware and software teams by providing insightful feedback, contributing to the continuous improvement of our technology.

We're looking for someone who has:

- Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex projects end-to-end with no oversight, taking full ownership of execution, delivery, and outcomes.

- Acts as a highly autonomous leader capable of proactively identifying and resolving obstacles, driving decisions, and escalating only critical business risks when necessary.

- Demonstrates strong leadership presence, operational decision-making, and accountability in fast-paced deployment environments while maintaining a high standard of execution and team coordination.

title: Strategic Advisory Services Principal Consultant (Remote, BRA)
description:

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed - we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:
CrowdStrike’s Strategic Advisory Services team assists our customers with a wide array of proactive engagements to help enhance security programs, educate employees, and develop tailored cyber initiatives. The Principal Consultant role is the leader on the ground. This role serves as the primary day-to-day lead for Strategic engagements, interacting with client leadership and ensuring that projects run on time and to our highest standards. Principal Consultants also assist our Strategic leadership team with staffing, thought leadership, business development, and other “back of office” tasks.

• Are you comfortable being the face of the company and dealing with difficult client situations where necessary?

• Are you ready to “do the work” while also supporting business line development activities?

• Do you enjoy leading and working alongside a team of A-players?

• Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?

• Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?

• Do you have strong communication and writing skills?

• Are you the smartest person on your current team? Would you prefer to engage peers who challenge you daily?

• Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts and public speaking events.

• Identify and address emerging trends in cybersecurity, drawing on both government and private sector perspectives.

• Manage internal programs and teams.

• Engage in some degree of sales and business development opportunities.

• Support staffing and scheduling of strategic resources on upcoming engagements.

description:

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Why Kong?
Every enterprise building microservices, cloud-native architectures, and generative AI workloads runs on APIs. Kong is the cloud-native API and AI connectivity company, trusted by Fortune 500s and millions of developers worldwide.

If you sell infrastructure, dev tools, or data platforms, you know what developer mindshare is worth. At Kong, you aren’t evangelizing unproven tech from scratch. You’re monetizing an existing open-source groundswell and partnering with enterprise architecture, security, and engineering leaders to power mission-critical API traffic.

What makes this role high-leverage

- A proven land-and-expand engine: Convert open-source and developer adoption into strategic, multi-year enterprise platform commitments (Kong Konnect, AI Gateway, Service Mesh).

- High-impact deals: Run complex, multi-threaded enterprise cycles (100k-1M+ ACV) across CTO, VP of Platform/Architecture, and CISO personas.

- Modern AI and cloud relevance: Put Kong at the center of the enterprise stack, securing, managing, and routing LLM traffic alongside traditional microservices.

- True cross-functional support: Backed by world-class Solutions Engineers, dedicated SDRs, Customer Success, and an active developer community.

- Full-cycle ownership: Your territory, your pipeline, your deals. You run everything from first outreach through negotiation to close.

- A voice in the product: What you hear from customers goes straight to product and marketing, and it shapes what we build and how we take it to market.

- Visibility: Represent Kong at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

What you bring

- Enterprise software track record: 5+ years of full-cycle closing with mid-market and enterprise logos (>1,000 employees), and consistent quota overachievement.

- Ecosystem literacy: Direct experience in modern B2B SaaS or infrastructure, ideally across commercial open source (COSS), developer platforms, cloud/networking, APIs, Kubernetes, or observability.

- Multi-persona discovery: You can work bottoms-up with technical champions (engineers, architects) and top-down with executive economic buyers (CTO, VP Eng, CISO).

- Strategic territory ownership: A disciplined MEDDPICC or Command of the Message approach to pipeline generation, accurate forecasting, and deal execution.

- Consultative selling: You find the customer’s actual problem, tie the solution to a business outcome, and tailor every demo to match.

- Negotiation under pressure: You’re comfortable in high-stakes conversations and build relationships that last past the signature.

- Account planning and CRM discipline: You research accounts and industry trends before you call, and you keep Salesforce (or similar) current enough to forecast from.

- Builder mindset: You thrive in a fast-moving, early-stage environment, take ownership of your territory, and adjust when the market shifts.

Why top sellers join us

- Clear category winner: Gartner Leader with top-tier adoption metrics and continuous product momentum.

- Uncapped upside: Highly competitive base/variable structure, accelerators, and equity.

- Culture of execution: Autonomous, fast-moving, and low on bureaucracy. Built for builders and closers.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

title: Call Center Sales Intake Specialist (Nicaragua)

About Us
Ovation Law Firm is a fast-growing, consumer-focused law firm committed to delivering exceptional legal services while fostering a high-performance, accountable, and supportive workplace. As we continue to scale, we are building strong client-focused systems to ensure consistency, compliance, and an outstanding experience from the very first interaction.
We work closely with partner legal teams to connect injured individuals with the legal support they need, and our intake team plays a critical role in setting the tone for every client relationship.
About the Role
We are seeking a high-energy, empathetic, and motivated Legal Intake Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for individuals seeking legal help after an injury.
In this role, your goal is to listen, qualify, and warmly introduce potential clients to our partner legal teams using an assumptive, sales-minded approach. You will guide callers through the early stages of their legal journey with confidence, compassion, and urgency, ensuring they feel heard, supported, and ready for the next step.
This is a fast-paced position well-suited for individuals with backgrounds in legal intake, sales, customer service, call centers, or customer acquisition of any kind, who thrive in high-volume environments and know how to balance empathy with performance.
Strong English communication skills are essential for success in this role.
Key Responsibilities

• Respond to incoming inquiries via phone, web forms, and chat in real time, providing rapid, attentive support to individuals seeking legal help after an injury.

• Conduct concise (5-8 minute), compassionate discovery calls to gather and assess essential case details such as incident information, injuries, liability, and insurance status.

• Apply proprietary scripts and strict qualification criteria to quickly determine whether a case is a fit for partner legal teams.

• Use an assumptive, sales-minded approach to perform live warm transfers to our partner legal teams or schedule timely callbacks for qualified leads.

• Accurately document all caller information, case details, and outcomes in Salesforce, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.

• Manage follow-ups for pending leads, maintaining an organized pipeline and re-engaging prospects who were not ready to proceed on initial contact.

Qualifications

• Strong English communication skills (C1 level), both verbal and written.

• Fully bilingual, fluent in both English and Spanish, with the ability to seamlessly support callers in either language.

• At least 1 year of experience in a high-volume call center, customer service, or medical/legal office environment.

• Exceptional verbal communication skills with the ability to mirror a caller’s tone, demonstrate empathy, and build rapport quickly.

• Sales-minded approach focused on educating callers and guiding them toward taking action on their personal injury matter.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable typing 45+ WPM while speaking with callers and navigating multiple software platforms simultaneously.

Nice-to-Have / Preferred Qualifications
The following experience is helpful but not required for success in this role:

• Personal injury intake experience.

• Experience with Salesforce.

Requirements

• Ability to work independently from a home office with stable, high-speed internet and a quiet, professional workspace.

• Must have a laptop or desktop computer with a minimum of 16GB RAM and an Intel Core i5 processor or higher.

• Must have a stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps.

• Available to work U.S. business hours.

• Willingness to use time-tracking software.

What We Offer

• Earn $8/hour DOE (full-time, 40 hours/week - including weekends).

• Performance based incentives.

• 100% remote work environment.

• 10 paid time-off (PTO) days per year.

• Opportunity to work closely with leadership and legal professionals in a growing, modern law firm.

title: Director of Marketing Operations
description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role
At Megaport, we don’t just do networks and compute - we change what’s possible in those industries. Our automated infrastructure powers businesses all over the globe, and we’re on the lookout for a Director of Marketing Operations with a knack for translating tasks into clear outcomes.
This is a critical role within the marketing department, overseeing the globally distributed Marketing Operations team. You will be responsible for setting the strategy and direction for the team, and supporting the wider marketing department through advancements in technology and tooling. You will be someone who is comfortable working in the tools of a modern marketing tech stack (Salesforce, Marketo, static sites, etc), and you are keen to kick things into warp speed with AI agent swarms, multi-agent orchestration, model chaining and MCP integrations.
This is a role for someone who loves building, moving fast and adapting to new ideas regularly. Someone who sees problems early, takes action, and keeps everyone pointed in the same direction. If you’re motivated by impact, enjoy working closely with senior leadership, and get satisfaction from strong execution, you’ll feel at home here.

title: Partner Manager
description:
ABOUT MIDDESK:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

About the role

We're looking for a senior Partner Manager to own and grow a portfolio of Middesk's most strategic partners. These are fintech and B2B platforms (identity, risk, fraud and onboarding providers) that embed, resell or refer Middesk to their customers. Partnerships influence a meaningful share of Middesk's revenue, and this role is responsible for growing it.

You'll be the main owner of each partner relationship, from executive alignment through to the commercial terms and the day-to-day work of getting shared customers live. That means growing usage across partners' customer bases, running a real co-sell motion with our sales team, and structuring partnerships so both sides are invested in growing together. You'll join a small team and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering and Customer Success.

We follow a hybrid work model, and this role is expected in our SF or NYC office 3 days per week. Candidates should be within commuting distance.
