- Own and grow a portfolio of strategic partners. You're accountable for both the revenue these partners drive and the health of each relationship. Be the primary owner across business, product and executive stakeholders, and keep each partnership multi-threaded so it keeps growing.

- Build and run joint growth plans. Set revenue and usage targets with each partner, find the whitespace in their customer base, and turn it into a clear plan you track and report on.

- Grow usage across shared customers. Work with Marketing and the partner's team on campaigns and enablement that get more of their customers live on Middesk and using more of our products.

- Run the co-sell motion. Work with AEs and SEs on partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals, following our co-selling rules of engagement, and help partners bring us into the right deals early.

- Lead commercial conversations. Negotiate expansions, pricing and renewals. Sell the full value of Middesk, and structure gives-and-gets that reward growth on both sides.

- Bring partner insight back to Middesk. Share what partners and their customers need with Product, and help shape roadmap and integration priorities.

- Own and improve the partner playbook. Run account planning, QBRs, enablement and performance tracking, and improve them as the function scales.

About you

- 5+ years in partnerships, account management, strategic sales or a similar customer-facing growth role, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or another complex or regulated space.

- A track record of growing revenue within existing partners or accounts, including expansions and renewals.

- Strong commercial instincts. You can size an opportunity, build a business case, and negotiate terms that hold up.

- Comfortable with technical, API-based products and with conversations involving partners' product and engineering teams.

- Able to build influence across large organizations, with both executives and operators.

description:
About the job
DRIP ist eine der führenden A/B-Testing Agenturen für D2C Brands im DACH-Raum.
Unser Ziel: Conversion Rate maximieren durch Rapid A/B-Testing und radikale Customer Insights.
Wir helfen Marken wie Snocks, Kickz, Blackroll, Hellofresh, Holy oder Elevate , ihre Conversion Rate zu optimieren.
Wir skalieren - und suchen dafür einen Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) , der den Top of Funnel füllt und qualifizierte Meetings für unser Sales Team bucht.
Aufgaben
The Position: Sales Development Representative (m/w/d)
Als Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) bist du die erste Stimme, die potenzielle Kunden von DRIP hören.
Du öffnest Türen bei D2C Brands, weckst Interesse in den ersten 10 Sekunden und übergibst qualifizierte Leads an unsere Account Executives.
Du arbeitest eng mit Sales & Founder Team, testest neue Ansprachen und Skripte und entwickelst dich messbar an deinen Zahlen.
Du liebst das Telefon, lässt dich von einem "Nein" nicht aus der Ruhe bringen und weißt: Cold Calling ist Handwerk - kein Glücksspiel.
Deine Aufgaben

•
Outbound Calling: Du führst täglich qualifizierte Cold Calls bei D2C Brands im DACH-Raum

•
Lead Qualifizierung: Du erkennst im Gespräch, ob ein Lead Fit ist - und übergibst sauber an den AE

•
Meeting Booking: Du buchst qualifizierte Termine in den Kalender unserer Account Executives

•
Multichannel Outreach: Du kombinierst Calls mit LinkedIn & Email für maximalen Impact

•
CRM & Reporting: Du dokumentierst sauber in Close, trackst deine KPIs und optimierst kontinuierlich

•
Skript-Testing: Du testest Openings, Pitches und Objection Handling - und iterierst datenbasiert

Qualifikation
Must-Haves:

• Du hast keine Angst vor dem Telefon - im Gegenteil

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit in Deutsch (Native) & Englisch

• Hohes Energielevel und Eigenantrieb - auch beim 80. Call des Tages

• Resilienz: Ein "Nein" wirft dich nicht aus der Bahn

• Klare, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und gutes Gespür für Menschen

• Erste Erfahrung im Outbound Sales / Cold Calling (B2B)

• Erfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig - Hauptsache du bist hungry

Bonus:

• Erfahrung mit D2C / E-Commerce Brands

• Erfahrung mit Tools wie Close, Apollo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator

• Erfahrung im Agenturvertrieb oder SaaS Sales

• Erfahrung im High-Stakes-Umfeld (Startups, Performance-Teams)

Benefits
Why join DRIP

•
Direkter Impact: Du füllst die Pipeline - ohne dich gibt es keinen Umsatz. Messbar und sichtbar.

•
Entwicklung: Klarer Karrierepfad zum Account Executive bei starker Performance

•
Training: Wöchentliches Sales-Coaching, Call-Reviews und Skript-Sparring mit einem Sales Experten

•
Remote + Offsites: Arbeite ortsunabhängig, regelmäßige Offsites für Fokus & Teambuilding

•
Vergütung: Fixgehalt + ungedeckelter Bonus pro gebuchtem & gehaltenem Meeting. Du hast es selbst in der Hand, was on top dazu kommt.

Application Process

•
Step 1: Klicke auf "Bewerben" / "Apply" und schick mir einfach eine kurze Sprachnachricht in der du DICH vorstellst

•
Step 2: Erstes Interview und Kennenlerngespräch

•
Step 3: Live Cold Calling Simulation

•
Step 4: Kennenlernen mit dem CEO

Wer hier nicht reinpasst

• Du hast Angst vor dem Telefon

• Du brauchst ständige Anleitung

• Du nimmst "Neins" persönlich

• Du denkst, die Welt schuldet dir was

title: Manager, Process Improvement
description:
Position Summary...
The Manager, Process Improvement identifies and leads process improvement work that resolves systemic gaps, improves operational execution, and prevents recurring issues across Marketplace Risk Operations. This role manages Process Improvement requests through discovery, stakeholder engagement, process analysis, SOP updates and implementation support to ensure work is clearly scoped, prioritized, documented, and completed effectively. This role partners with cross- functional teams to align strategies, simplify processes, and drive operational efficiency. By fostering collaboration and continuous improvement, this position supports long-term business goals and delivers measurable results that enhance organizational performance and stakeholder engagement. What you'll do...
About the team:
The Process Improvement team supports Risk Operations by strengthening operational processes, optimizing workflows, and addressing systemic gaps. The team partners with Product, Business, Change Management and other teams to align stakeholders, improve documentation, support intake and prioritization, and drive consistent execution. Through process improvement and change initiatives, the team simplifies and sustains operations, improves efficiency, and delivers measurable business outcomes that support Risk Operations' strategic objectives.
What you'll do:

• Lead process improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, reduce risk, and support business objectives.

• Analyze processes to identify gaps, root causes, and opportunities for standardization and optimization.

• Manage intake requests by conducting discovery, assessing urgency and impact, and executing required process or documentation updates.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to clarify process impacts, align stakeholders, resolve dependencies, and support informed decision-making.

• Support implementation readiness for process updates by defining requirements, documentation needs, handoffs, and success measures.

• Serve as a process subject matter expert by providing guidance on policies, tools, controls, and best practices.

• Evaluate the effectiveness of process changes, using data and feedback to drive continuous improvement.

What you'll bring:

• Proven expertise in process improvement and change management to drive operational efficiency and sustainable solutions.

• Strong leadership skills with experience managing cross-functional teams and mentoring associates.

• Demonstrated ability to develop, implement, and monitor process design, mapping, and management initiatives.

• Proficiency in project management, including planning, executing, and delivering transformational change projects.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to secure alignment and buy-in across business units.

• Ability to analyze data, identify gaps, and recommend actionable improvements aligned with business goals.

• Knowledge of lean methodologies and industry best practices to support continuous improvement efforts.

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

Peraton is hiring a Mainframe Security Administrator for a remote position supporting our CMS program.
